name: relayer-mcp
description: Set up and manage a self-hosted XNS Relayer — S3-compatible object storage — conversationally.
long_description:
XNS Relayer is S3-compatible object storage you host yourself: $0 egress, uncapped, on hardware you control. This extension gives Claude 15 tools that walk the whole lifecycle — check prerequisites, register an XNS account, install the Relayer via Docker Compose, claim it to your account, choose which hosts store your data (VPD), verify an S3 round trip, provision CLI credentials, then handle day-2 work: settings, service restarts, and configuration backups.

The server runs locally on your machine and talks to your Relayer over loopback or your private network only — connections to public addresses are refused by design. Sign-in happens in your browser against XNS's identity service; the agent never sees your password.

tools.name: check_prerequisites
tools.description: Check Docker, ports, disk space, and network reachability before installing.

tools.name: start_registration
tools.description: Get the browser URL for creating an XNS account.

tools.name: check_email_verified
tools.description: Wait for the new account's email address to be verified.

tools.name: install_relayer
tools.description: Install and start the Relayer with Docker Compose.

tools.name: check_relayer_health
tools.description: Report the health of each Relayer service and its monitoring sidecars.

tools.name: start_claim
tools.description: Begin linking this Relayer installation to an XNS account.

tools.name: check_claim_status
tools.description: Wait for the browser claim to complete.

tools.name: get_host_tags
tools.description: List the host tags available for choosing where data is stored.

tools.name: configure_vpd
tools.description: Choose which hosts store your data, or preview the choice first.

tools.name: verify_storage
tools.description: Prove the S3 gateway works with an upload-and-download round trip.

tools.name: setup_cli_credentials
tools.description: Provision S3 credentials so the XNS CLI works without further setup.

tools.name: describe_settings
tools.description: List the adjustable Relayer settings with their current values.

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restart one Relayer service or all of them.

tools.name: manage_backups
tools.description: List, create, restore, or delete Relayer configuration backups.
